# .NET Conf companion

Use the SDK/workload versions pinned in global.json. This is a native MAUI app targeting iOS and Android. The same project also builds for Linux desktop (`net11.0`) and the browser (`net11.0-browser` plus `src/DotNetConf.App.Browser`) through Avalonia.Controls.Maui; code for those targets sits behind `AVALONIA` or in `Platforms/Avalonia`. The schedule planner in `Planner/` is an Avalonia control on every target; Android and iOS embed it in the native app. Optional showcase integrations are deferred.

Keep conference/search/schedule logic in DotNetConf.Core and presentation in DotNetConf.App. Preserve typed compiled XAML bindings, native navigation, semantic light/dark tokens, font scaling, and visible error states. All app-owned UI icons use IconFont.Maui.FluentIcons typed glyphs. Conference sessions and profiles come only from the public Microsoft conference feed and its validated on-device cache; photographs use approved public URLs supplied by that feed. Never bundle an agenda, speaker profiles/photos, or fictional community events; a fresh offline install must show an honest empty/download state. Do not invent unpublished details or use private organizer enrichment. Test-only prose is synthetic and must remain clearly marked.

Keep PRIVACY.md and the bundled Resources/Raw/PRIVACY.txt synchronized when data flows change. Preserve third-party license texts, notices, and artwork credits; permission to redistribute bundled branding does not make that artwork MIT-licensed. Release builds must not include DevFlow or development-only logging.

For live inspection, restore the repo-local tool and use `dotnet tool run maui -- devflow`. Inspect `devflow list` first and select the intended agent port. Read the UI tree before interactions; use stable AutomationIds and a single `devflow batch` for related mutations to avoid lease conflicts. The DevFlow package, registration, and any development-only settings must remain Debug-only. Never inspect or change another app's data.

Run the core tests and relevant platform build after changes. Keep generated screenshots/logs outside the repository. See README.md for build, inspection, and data-contract instructions.
